issue.title: sase-telegram CI: extractions/setup-just@v2 intermittently fails with 'no release for just matching version specifier'
issue.description: sase-org/sase-telegram CI (check 3.12 and check 3.13 jobs) intermittently fails at the extractions/setup-just@v2 step with ##[error]no release for just matching version specifier. Reproduced 3 times in a row on the same commit 62ddbda (fix(tests): build the flag_triage test gate through its real factory) across reruns of workflow run https://github.com/sase-org/sase-telegram/actions/runs/32035997991 -- each rerun failed at the identical setup-just step, alternating which of check (3.12)/(3.13) hit the error first (the other job then shows cancelled/skipped). Confirmed via 'gh run view 32035997991 --repo sase-org/sase-telegram --log-failed': the step logs 'Run extractions/setup-just@v2' then immediately errors with 'no release for just matching version specifier' after ~10s, with no other diagnostic. Likely cause: GitHub API rate limiting on unauthenticated requests made by extractions/setup-just@v2 to resolve the 'just' release matching its version specifier, or a release-metadata problem with that action version. This is pre-existing CI infra flakiness, not caused by or specific to commit 62ddbda -- that commit is a correct, locally-verified fix (just check passed: 581 tests, ruff/mypy clean) that is blocked from showing green CI purely by this infra issue. Proposed fix: pin extractions/setup-just to an explicit just version instead of resolving 'latest'/an unpinned specifier, and/or pass a github-token input to the action to avoid unauthenticated API rate limits, or switch to an alternative just-install method (e.g. install via cargo or a pinned release URL directly).
